scope: Independent local audit of the three completed A53 E-plus-meter windows. No router/Oracle access, build, workload, staging, deployment or flash by this audit.
checks: Every archive digest, safe unique regular-file/directory member, manifest and retained extracted-file hash matched: 44 files per window.
Exact diagnostic file/live ELF, staged measurement-tool identities, isolated daemon netns and config digests matched every window.
The reused validator is byte-identical to frozen 7c93cfb1. Relocating only the existing case root path reconstructs exact case SHA79f4d3e9; its set-e final daemon wait precedes COMPLETE.
All three case exits and daemon exits are zero with COMPLETE. No stderr errors; controller output is the expected isolated-loopback namespace receipt.

Prewarm, warmup and measurement scheduled/sent/correct counts are 1000/1000/4000 per window, with zero timeout, wrong, transport error or skips. Binary record counts/status/IDs and send-lag membership independently match.
Exactly 800 upstream requests/replies per window occur in setup/warmup, with zero measurement upstream requests and no upstream error/drop. TTL120 and delay1000us match the frozen hit workload.
All raw matrices, query counts, histogram sums and weighted sums, actual cached denominators, whole-turn sums and published derived values match independent calculations.

counts.cached_denominator_rule: Read the actual Cached step count, including cache hits during prewarm. Neither 5000 queries nor the cached-only turn count is the denominator.
counts.whole_turn_categories_retained: no_packet, cached_only, mixed_or_other; all three matrices independently matched the raw report and author result.

postflight.scope: Local audit of captured postflight fields/stdout, not a fresh device query.

limits: The ELF exceeds the unchanged release size gate and is strictly excluded diagnostic evidence. Its CPU/latency values cannot support performance, candidate acceptance or deployment.
Cached-only turn averages are conditional, not all-turn averages. no_packet turns can handle upstream completions or control work; no-packet/error steps are not an EAGAIN syscall count.
Whole-turn totals cover the normal owner loop, excluding preceding initialization, report formatting and later teardown. Requested-minus-released bytes do not establish a leak.
Allocator byte counts are request/release traffic, not physical malloc footprint, RSS or USS. Separate realloc counts remain visible.
The 95 retained process observations each show one thread. These samples are not continuous thread tracing.
Numerical agreement with an earlier API-subset count does not identify each dynamic allocation site, compare C allocation cost or prove uninstrumented speed.
